name: Exp_ColorXTRIX_Histogram
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXTRIX_Histogram custom indicator, which is a triple-smoothed momentum oscillator. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position closing on signal reversal.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXTRIX_Histogram自定义指标进行交易，该指标是三重平滑动量振荡器。当直方图向上翻转时开多仓，向下翻转时开空仓，并可在信号反转时配置平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用ColorXTRIX_Histogram指标作为核心策略，该指标基于三重指数平滑算法（XTRIX）计算动量。入场条件为：当直方图值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓；当直方图值从上升转为下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件依赖信号反转平仓以及固定的止损止盈设置，支持独立控制买卖方向的开启和平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金比例，支持多种保证金模式包括固定手数、余额百分比等。该策略使用多周期平滑方法（JJMA、JurX、ParMA等）来减少噪音，但也因此引入了较大的滞后性。策略缺乏对市场波动率、点差和交易时间段的过滤，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the ColorXTRIX_Histogram indicator as its core strategy, which calculates momentum based on a triple exponentially smoothed algorithm (XTRIX). Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the histogram value turns from declining to rising (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]); a sell position opens when the histogram value turns from rising to declining (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions rely on signal reversal-based closing and fixed stop-loss/take-profit settings, with independent control for buy and sell direction opening and closing. Position sizing is controlled through the MM parameter with multiple margin modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage. The strategy employs multiple smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) to reduce noise, but this introduces significant lag. The strategy lacks filters for market volatility, spread, and trading sessions, making it prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter, lots or ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots, balance percentage, etc.)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Close long positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions on signal reversal

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description_en: Smoothing phase (JJMA: -100~+100, VIDYA: CMO period, AMA: fast MA period)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0 for current bar)

pros: 使用多重平滑算法减少市场噪音，信号质量相对较高
买卖方向可独立控制开仓和平仓，灵活性较好
支持多种资金管理模式和仓位计算方式
有固定止损止盈保护，风险可控
默认H4周期操作，避免短线噪音干扰
pros_en: Uses multiple smoothing algorithms to reduce market noise, resulting in relatively high signal quality
Independent control for buy/sell direction opening and closing provides good flexibility
Supports multiple money management modes and position sizing methods
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit provide risk control
Default H4 timeframe avoids short-term noise interference
cons: 缺乏点差过滤，在高点差时段可能产生不利入场
无交易时间段过滤，可能在低流动性时段交易
三重平滑导致信号滞后，可能错过最佳入场时机
默认止损1000点而止盈2000点，在某些品种上止损可能过大
没有持仓数量检查，可能在已有持仓时重复开仓
指标句柄创建失败时仅打印错误但未清理资源
cons_en: No spread filter, may enter at unfavorable prices during high-spread periods
No trading session filter, may trade during low-liquidity periods
Triple smoothing causes signal lag, potentially missing optimal entry points
Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points may be excessively large for some instruments
No position count check, may open duplicate positions when existing positions are already held
Indicator handle creation failure only prints error without resource cleanup
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时间段过滤，避免不利条件下入场
增加持仓检查逻辑，防止同方向重复开仓
增加波动率自适应的止损止盈机制，替代固定点数设置
增加移动止损（追踪止损）功能以保护浮动利润
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid entering under unfavorable conditions
Add position check logic to prevent duplicate opening in the same direction
Add volatility-adaptive stop-loss/take-profit mechanism instead of fixed point settings
Add trailing stop functionality to protect floating profits

risk_points: 缺乏点差过滤和交易时间过滤，可能在不利条件下入场
无持仓数量检查，可能导致重复开仓增加风险敞口
固定止损1000点在部分品种上风险偏大
risk_points_en: No spread filter or trading session filter, may enter under unfavorable conditions
No position count check, may lead to duplicate position opening increasing risk exposure
Fixed 1000-point stop-loss may be excessively risky for some instruments
